none: PAS NLM-C5B184: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine from Roxby cum Risby
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of House of Constantine, Urbs Roma issue of 330-340, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Helmeted bust left. Obverse inscription: [VRBS ROMA]. Reverse description: Wolf suckling twins. Cliff Reeves kindly examined this coin. Diameter: 17.7mm, Weight: 1.64gms, die axis: 6
